verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for an IP office's online services and data portal, so the axis applies. The pack does not show it is delivered. The docs cover only human-facing web filing (trademarks, patents, designs, e-Soleau) and database search, with no API, CLI or automation documentation. The single probe got an HTTP 403 on a keyless GET to data.inpi.fr. Its note that access needs an account-issued token is an unverified inference, and nothing shows a working token-based or scriptable workflow.
